text:
riya-sec: spotted partner-supplied tarball with envs in s3://partner-drop/2026-05-03/dump.tar.gz. contains VAULT_ADDR and a KMS ciphertext header string. tagging @oscar-ops @lee-eng for containment.

oscar-ops: do not delete. snapshot uploaded to gs://forensics/partner-drop/1875556666/dump.tar.gz and removing partner-read from bucket ACL now.

lee-eng: can you paste the ciphertext header? need to confirm key resource id.

riya-sec: header shows: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/wrap-v2. looks like our key id. assume decrypt possible.

lee-eng: immediate actions: 1) temp deny partner principals on that key 2) enumerate decrypt callers in last 30d 3) disable suspicious SA keys 4) schedule transit key rotate + staged rewrap. commands I'll run: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt" --freshness=30d --format=json | jq -r '.[].protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail' | sort -u` and `vault write -f transit/keys/wrap-v2/rotate`.

oscar-ops: applied bucket ACL lockdown. snapshot artifact attached to INC-2026-121.

alert-bot: Incident INC-2026-121 created (P1) assigned to @riya-sec.

naya-pm: I'll notify partner security and legal; draft ready in the incident ticket for review.

lee-eng: disabled two long-lived SA keys that showed decrypt activity and created short-lived replacements. starting a canary rewrap for prefix `ingest/2026/05/` (2k objects) at low throttle.

oscar-ops: canary rewrap completed: 2k objects, no failures. enabling KMS audit export to gs://secure-audit/ingest/1875556666 and wiring alerts on decrypt calls from non-platform principals.

riya-sec: add pipeline guard to reject uploads containing VAULT_ADDR or `VAULT_TOKEN` plaintext and an alert on large base64 blocks. PR opened.

lee-eng: scheduling bulk rewrap with batching and concurrency controls; will post ETA in the incident. moving to monitoring.

riya-sec: interim incident closed; follow-ups: postmortem, RBAC policy PR to narrow cryptoKey encrypter role, partner engagement doc. leaving thread open until artifacts published.
